title: Genesis Bible Quiz - Chapter 6
description: Ten questions on Genesis 6: the wickedness of man, Noah who found favor, and God's instructions for the ship.

questions.text: What limit did Yahweh set on man's days?
questions.explanation: Yahweh said his Spirit would not strive with man forever, because he is flesh; so his days would be one hundred twenty years.

questions.text: Who were in the earth in those days, according to verse 4?
questions.explanation: The Nephilim were in the earth in those days, and also after that.

questions.text: What did Yahweh see about man on the earth?
questions.explanation: Yahweh saw that the wickedness of man was great in the earth, and every imagination of his heart was continually only evil.

answers.text: He had stopped working the ground
He had forgotten how to build

questions.explanation: Noah was a righteous man, blameless among the people of his time. Noah walked with God.

questions.text: From what wood did God tell Noah to make the ship?
questions.explanation: God said, "Make a ship of gopher wood."

questions.text: With what was Noah to seal the ship inside and outside?
questions.explanation: God told Noah to make rooms in the ship and to seal it inside and outside with pitch.

questions.text: How long was the ship to be?
questions.explanation: The length of the ship was to be three hundred cubits, its width fifty cubits, and its height thirty cubits.

questions.text: Where was Noah to set the door of the ship?
questions.explanation: God said, "You shall set the door of the ship in its side."

questions.text: How many of every sort of living thing was Noah to bring into the ship in Genesis 6?
questions.explanation: God told Noah to bring two of every sort into the ship, male and female, to keep them alive.

questions.text: How did Noah respond to all of God's instructions?
questions.explanation: Thus Noah did. He did all that God commanded him.

answers.text: He asked God for a sign first
He did all that God commanded him
